description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelLoadSignedButton class, a custom widget for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It provides functionality to render a button/link in the subpanel interface that allows users to load signed documents related to contracts, with conditions based on contract status and template type.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelLoadSignedButton
classes.description: A widget class for displaying a 'Load Signed Document' button in the subpanel under contract documents.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space for the header cell display, effectively rendering an empty header.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the 'Load Signed Document' link/button, incorporating URL parameters and conditional visibility based on contract status and template type.
